from pathlib import Path
import json

def write_text(path, text):
    p = Path(path)
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text)

def read_json(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())

def write_json(path, value):
    write_text(path, json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

def replace_once(path, old, new):
    p = Path(path)
    text = p.read_text()
    count = text.count(old)
    assert count == 1, f"{path}: anchor count={count} for {old[:80]!r}"
    p.write_text(text.replace(old, new))

# Aggregate denominator reconciliation.
neutral_path = 'data/research/k0-role-neutral-denominator.json'
neutral = read_json(neutral_path)
neutral['status'] = 'execution_started_wave_05_field_complete'
w05 = next(row for row in neutral['discovery_waves'] if row['wave_id'] == 'K0-W05')
w05['status'] = 'discovery_complete_field_adjudication_complete'
w05['field_adjudication_path'] = 'data/research/k0-wave05-field-adjudication.json'
write_json(neutral_path, neutral)

# Coverage reconciliation.
coverage_path = 'data/research/corpus-coverage.json'
coverage = read_json(coverage_path)
lane = next(row for row in coverage['lanes'] if row['lane_id'] == 'epistemic-admissibility-ceiling-events')
pending = next(row for row in lane['metrics'] if row['metric_id'] == 'candidate_records_pending_field_audit')
pending['observed'] = 0
pending['source'] = 'data/research/k0-wave05-field-adjudication.json'
gap = next(row for row in lane['known_gaps'] if row['gap_id'] == 'k0-wave05-field-adjudication-open')
gap['description'] = 'All eight Wave 05 records received maintainer field review: one supported-for-human-review packet, one candidate-only packet, one negative control, three counterpower controls, one correction control, and one coverage control; none became an included event.'
gap['status'] = 'resolved_at_maintainer_layer'
gap['next_action'] = 'Preserve the publication-gate field packet for independent review; acquire the Karolinska causal bridge and the complete Olivieri attribution and remedy record before proposing any event.'
write_json(coverage_path, coverage)

# Adversarial-review reconciliation.
reviews_path = 'data/research/selection-adversarial-reviews.json'
reviews = read_json(reviews_path)
review = next(row for row in reviews['reviews'] if row['lane_id'] == 'epistemic-admissibility-ceiling-events')
same_gate = next(row for row in review['comparator_tests'] if row['test_id'] == 'same-gate-opposite-outcome-controls')
same_gate['status'] = 'partial_wave01_wave02_wave03_wave04_wave05_field_complete'
same_gate['blocking_conditions'] = [
    'controls remain maintainer-selected',
    'Wave 05 dispositions remain maintainer-only',
    'three frozen query templates remain unexecuted',
    'second-party review absent'
]
publication = next(row for row in review['comparator_tests'] if row['test_id'] == 'publication-gate-and-correction-controls')
publication['status'] = 'maintainer_field_complete'
publication['blocking_conditions'] = [
    'the Karolinska packet does not establish the causal bridge from contradiction to knower reclassification',
    'the Olivieri packet remains a maintainer-supported CCD-6 review candidate rather than an included event',
    'later correction cannot be projected backward into prior knowledge or motive',
    'policy existence does not prove observed stopping power',
    'second-party review absent'
]
review['disposition'] = 'Five name-blind waves and all five maintainer field packets now preserve employment, access, safety-warning, committee-reset, publication-gate, negative, coverage, correction, conflict-management, and counterpower records. Publication remains blocked because three query templates, the Temu request-level acquisition, exact remote custody, and genuinely independent review remain incomplete.'
write_json(reviews_path, reviews)
